DRDUNGEON ROWv0.5.1 · HP + ATK TEST

Every enemy is your next card.

Click Heal or Block to activate it on yourself; click again to deactivate it. For Attack, click an effect and then a monster. Move or remove assignments freely before ending the turn.

    You cannot Endure a boss. The next stage enters during refill and cannot attack until the following turn. Defeat Stage 3 to win immediately. At 0 HP or below, your run ends immediately.

    Settings apply to the next run. Starting replaces the current run; export it first if you want to keep it.
